observed_before_extension.interpretation: Depth 5 falsified the registered degradation endpoint, but the cumulative bundle had not converged and continued to grow.

extension_rationale: Unlike the bounded recursive manager, cumulative success has no fixed-size state. Extending only the already running treatment from layers 6 through 10 is an economical exploratory test of delayed context-complexity thresholds. The original five-layer decision remains unchanged.

exploratory_signals.delayed_terminal_drop: Layer-10 mean Core is at least 0.20 below the matching no-transfer layer-5 mean of 0.90.
exploratory_signals.within_extension_drop: Layer-10 mean Core is at least 0.20 below the maximum treatment mean over layers 5 through 9.
exploratory_signals.monotone_tail: At least two transitions from layers 6 through 10 strictly decrease.
exploratory_signals.complexity: Reference count and received experience characters continue increasing beyond layer 5.
exploratory_signals.interpretation_rule: A signal is exploratory because depth 10 was selected after observing the five-layer endpoint; any positive result requires a fresh preregistered depth-10 replication.
